notes.title: Project UNSEEK Release Date Annoucement
notes.notes:
Exciting news all!

After almost two years of development, Project UNSEEK finally has a release date, and it will be released on [b]10 November 2023 (GMT+7)[/b]!

[previewyoutube=SHBSX6mViPU;full][/previewyoutube]

What to expect on the full release version of Project UNSEEK?
[list]
[*]3 New Playable Characters
In the full release of Project UNSEEK, you will be able to play previously locked characters on the demo: Tech tinker girl J-Li, Faithfully religious boy Christopher, and Creature, inspired by Indonesian urban legend, the thief Boar Demon. More about them will be showcased on our social media, so stay tuned!

[*]2 New Map Variant
In the full-release version of Project UNSEEK, you will able to play at 2 previously locked maps, Deep Middle and Crew Quarter, a variant of Quiet Hills and Testing Lab.

[*]Improved art and animation
We have polished several assets and animations for better enjoyment of the game.

[*]Bug Fix
We try to wipe out a lot of bugs we can find, so hopefully, your gameplay will have fewer hiccups.
[/list]

We hope you are as excited as we are! Before the release day, you can try the demo with your friends, and if you enjoy your gameplay, please add it to your Steam wishlist and spread your experience with everyone!

notes.title: Q1 2023 Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Welcome to our newest development blog of Project UNSEEK.
It’s already the end of March! Q1 of 2023 just ended. It’s time to report some of the developments and updates we have done thus far. Let’s go!

[list]
[*][b]Map update[/b]
[/list] We’re testing new layout variations of our maps. Also, all of the maps will have more 3D assets than ever!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/8bad852b4b2419448cb0b97e9204be99dcb3ddaf.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/24f49eb34c47308dbb2b7947707ddd47711f2e35.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/09004ed23a2e0c3b39e74e0b977e52d33efbf1ef.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/76be1e37e9e65fe79f31051984ca91e665420e25.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]UI/UX update[/b]
[/list] We’re updating some UI in the main menu and lobby room to create a more streamlined experience.
Main Menu:
- You can now exit the game directly from the main menu.
- Select the server region in the main menu.
Lobby:
- You can now invite Steam friends to join using the in-game button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/d8912dff9c3e9c9b4c6443770a95fe049ffb824f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/49d487f30dfea293fd4967272771a09e9e7d804a.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Steam Integration[/b]
[/list] Project UNSEEK is now integrated with Steam. Some of the notable features:
- Stream friends game invite
- Show your in-game status on your Steam profile status.
- Steam Achievement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/856b62d66d0c31a3dfc83f70111d3db8625331f4.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]New character and basic items[/b]
[/list] We’re working on adding more colorful characters that we’ll reveal to you later. Stay tuned!
[list]
[*][b]Character customization[/b]
[/list] In case you missed our demo in steam next fest, we’re implementing character customization to personalize your character from hat to trousers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/2d38bf797d94b5b6f4b0458eac1ceef544035a52.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]
[/list] We’re adding a selection of tutorials for new players to learn about the basics of the game. The prompt will appear when you play the game for the first time, or you can access it later using the Journal menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/3c79ef2cae923d694138a44a35852f23f4f8b0ca.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Voice chat[/b]
[/list] You can enable voice chat in every session, and the room master can also enable proximity voice chat to add more immersion to the session.
[list]
[*][b]Non-Randomized Mode[/b]
[/list] We are working on adding a non-randomized role mode to add more variety to your gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/2106861956747749be119719a15c6f8dd54c52f2.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Audio update[/b]
[/list] We’re working with talented artists to add voice-over and new background music to add a more immersive experience to the game.
[list]
[*][b]Better controller support implementation in the menu[/b]
[/list] Awkward pseudo cursor no more!
[list]
[*][b]Bug fixing and polishing[/b]
[/list] As usual, our programmer works hard to fix everything whenever we add new features.

That’s it for the development update. Can’t wait to see our game in action when it is finally released.

But wait, there’s more!
Earlier this week, Some of our team just safely landed back from San Francisco, attending GCA and GDC, but because most of them are about deals and stuff, we can’t tell you much about it now. One thing really important is we learned so much from the conference and meeting with fellow developers from around the world, and we’re really excited to implement all we learned there in our games and company.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/a12a84b2b61596be55c421485040f40ffd89dc82.jpg[/img]
And one last thing, we’re in the really early phase of developing our new games, and we are inviting all of you to participate in the early development by joining our research survey! 
Requirement: NONE. Everyone is welcome to participate.

Fill out the form: [url=https://bit.ly/join-arsanesia-concepttesting]https://bit.ly/join-arsanesia-concepttesting[/url]

Based on what you fill in, Selected individuals will be asked to fill out another form for the game concept testing and will receive a reward!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/fb8657593323b45b776715d79e879275f014927c.png[/img]
That’s it for this development blog! Thank you so much for reading this long blog. See you next time in the next news and update!

notes.title: Project UNSEEK October 2022 Development Update
notes.notes:
Project UNSEEK October 2022 Development Update

Hello everyone, it’s been a while since we wrote about our development progress.

In October, we developed new characters and implemented significant mechanics for Project UNSEEK. We also have news about the events we participate in and what we plan in the near future.

Let’s get into it!

[h1]New Playable Characters[/h1]
You can now play as Britanny and Alien. In previous builds, you could only play as Jack and Dr. Plague. Let us introduce them all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/df921a4573f78b5c0ae66599da132cc5d22eccb3.png[/img]

[h3]Brittany (NEW!)[/h3]
The only female human character so far. A popular girl in her school loves playing pranks, cruel jokes, and insulting others to show dominance with her gang. Basically, A teen rom-com movie antagonist.

With her special skill: [b]Materialistic[/b], she can help other humans escape the experiment through her instinct to find the most precious item on the maps.

[h3]Jack[/h3]
A popular baseball athlete in his school has a handsome face and an athletic body, but he’s arrogant, hot-headed, and rude. Love to fight and certified bully.

With his special skill: [b]Sprint[/b], he can run faster than any creature (and human) in the experiment ground.

[h3]Alien (NEW!)[/h3]
Found stranded in an undisclosed area. Believed from outer space in our universe. Have high adaptability living on earth because of their ability to mimic humans.

Has special abilities: [b]Quick Mimic[/b], visually transforms into one random human in the experiment ground, and [b]Observer Offspring[/b], summons a youngling on the ground to reveal humans location nearby.

[h3]Dr. Plague[/h3]
Believed to be a doctor from another universe where a deadly outbreak decimated the earth. Mutated so much because of the disease, it is considered almost a human creature by researchers.

Has special abilities: [b]Otherwordly Concoction[/b], brews a strengthening potion and consumes it to move faster, and [b]Mark of the Sunbreak[/b], every time it catches a human, leaves a mark behind, reducing human’s movement speed.

[h1]Items and Skills Mechanics[/h1]
Now every character can utilize skill, as explained above. Also, special for humans can use items scattered around the experiment ground to help them finish their objectives.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/3eca28dabd6a30aa7f59ad6ba3ac4357c23b290a.png[/img]
[h3]Big Lamp[/h3]
Big lamp with limited fuel. Your field of view will be larger for a certain duration.

[h3]Baseball Bat[/h3]
Old baseball bat with rotten wood to knock creatures down.
[h3]
Instruction Manual[/h3]
Instruction Manual for old computers. Boost some progress on computer hacking.

[h3]Ritual Dagger[/h3]
The bloody ritual dagger is used for otherworldly rituals. Its mystic power has the ability to help escape from Creature's grasp.

[h1]Other updates:[/h1]
Other than the updates above, we’re also making some changes to the game's overall experience

[h3]Visual revamp
[/h3]
We’re revamping the overall art style with a new style, combining 2D and 3D assets to create a stylish and functional visual.

[h3]New UI/UX[/h3]
Inspired by mystery movie visuals and old computers, we’re creating a new UI to create more immersive experiences.

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
As the game is in development, there are still a lot of bugs found in the build, and we’re trying to fix them on every new version.

[h1]Events[/h1]
Besides development, Project UNSEEk is also attending and featured in various offline and online events.

[h3]Level Up Kuala Lumpur[/h3]

Thanks to support from Asosiasi Game Indonesia, Project UNSEEK can attend and open a booth at Level UP KLM. At the event, we met incredible people from the games industry and received feedback and insight from them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/4dccfbbc295ec5db3883de39add0cff80d261c64.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gamescom Asia[/h3]

Our first time attending an international event independently was a great experience. Even though the event is B2B only, we have so many visitors at our booth, from students, game dev, publisher, and the legendary Shuhei Yoshida of Playstation, that give us much valuable feedback and appreciation.
This event also has events on Steam and Project UNSEEK featured on the event page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/f681eeb821a5a44147f8665a50b912400e8d4f0b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Steam Scream Fest[/h3]

Our first-time event on Steam (Not including the Gamescom Asia one), a Halloween event featuring a lot of horror games Steam has to offer. At the event, we’re doing a Livestream on steam, talking about the development of Project UNSEEK and playing the game with the development team. We’re also doing a playtest session on our discord that we will explain next.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/ea8f548f1dddfdd5de357d899f15ada219e72afd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Playtest Session October[/h3]

At the end of October, we’re doing playtest session with our discord server member and other game developers. At the event, we’re introducing all the new features and fixes and getting valuable feedback from all testers participating. This event is also our first time distributing the playtest build via Steam, it’s a great learning experience for using Steam for the first time.


[h1]The Future[/h1]
As the development continues, we plan to add more features and characters to Project UNSEEK. We’re also trying to improve the game based on all feedback we receive.
[h3]
Monthly Playtest Session[/h3]

We plan to hold monthly playtest sessions as a regular event. By the end of November, we will have another playtest session with our Discord Member. You can also join the event by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/N2vBaxHhH7]Discord Server[/url].

[h3]
Steam Next Fest 2023[/h3]

We are committed to participating in the Steam Next Fest Event on February 2023 Please stay tuned for more information because we will have a demo you can play!

That's it for this development blog; thank you for your time reading this long blog and your support so far! See you in the next updates!


[b]Note:[/b] Work in progress. The gameplay and visuals shown or described in this blog might change in the final release.
